dossier.heat: Corporate Heat. Evidence becomes liability before it becomes truth.

dossier.factions: Crownline Infrastructure; Bastion Dynamics; civic compromise chain.

maps.note: Established, elegant, elven. An enclave of older status and polished exclusions.

maps.note: Built on ruins, built over lies, still standing. Every wall remembers earlier arrangements.

maps.note: Forgotten, abandoned, still surviving. The city forgets people here until it needs them moved.
